title: Getting Directions
synopsis: When asking for how to get somewhere in Beijing, make sure to know which direction you are facing.

fullText.simplified:
我不知道“东南西北”
 
小明：阿姨您好，请问北京大学怎么走？
阿姨：你去北大哪个门？
小明：哪个门最近？
阿姨：这儿离东门最近。
小明：那我去东门吧。
阿姨：去东门的话，你先往北走，到第一个路口往西拐，直走，到第四个路口就是中关村北大街，沿着北大街往北走七百米左右，就到了。
小明：不好意思，阿姨，我不知道“东南西北”，您能用“左右”吗？
阿姨：怎么“东南西北”都不清楚？我看看，你先往左走，到第一个路口左拐，直走，到第四个路口过马路，再右拐，过马路一直走，走大概七百米就到了。哎呀，我跟你一起过去吧， 就当锻炼了。
小明：谢谢阿姨，太麻烦您了！
阿姨：没事没事，走吧！
fullText.traditional:
我不知道“東南西北”
 
小明：阿姨您好，請問北京大學怎麼走？
阿姨：你去北大哪個門？
小明：哪個門最近？
阿姨：這兒離東門最近。
小明：那我去東門吧。
阿姨：去東門的話，你先往北走，到第一個路口往西拐，直走，到第四個路口就是中關村北大街，沿著北大街往北走七百米左右，就到了。
小明：不好意思，阿姨，我不知道“東南西北”，您能用“左右”嗎？
阿姨：怎麼“東南西北”都不清楚？我看看，你先往左走，到第一個路口左拐，直走，到第四個路口過馬路，再右拐，過馬路一直走，走大概七百米就到了。哎呀，我跟你一起過去吧， 就當鍛鍊了。
小明：謝謝阿姨，太麻煩您了！
阿姨：沒事沒事，走吧！

raw.synopsis: When asking for how to get somewhere in Beijing, make sure to know which direction you are facing.
sentence_translations: I don't know “east, south, west, north”
Xiao Ming: Hello Mrs, may I ask you how to get to Beijing University?
A yi: Which gate of Beijing University do you want to go?
Xiao Ming: Which one is the closest?
A yi: The east gate is the closest from here.
Xiao Ming: Then I will go to the east gate.
A yi: If you want to go to the east gate, first walk north, turn west at the first crossing, ..
.. keep on walking straight and at the forth crossing you’ll arrive at Zhongguancun North Street.
Walk north along the street for 700 meters and you’ll arrive at the gate.
Xiao Ming: Sorry Mrs., I don’t know the “east, south, west, north” directions. Could you please use “left and right” instead?
A yi: How could you not know the different directions?
Let me see, start walking to the left, turn left at the first crossing, keep on walking to the forth crossing, then cross the road.
Turn right and cross the road, walk along the road for about 700 meters and you’ll arrive.
You know what. I’ll go with you instead, it is good exercise.
Xiao Ming: Thanks Mrs. Sorry for troubling you.
A yi: It’s alright. Let’s go.
